title: Spock's reverence for the sun

tellings.quote: because he was talking about how we really don't understand the the value of our son

plain: At his first overseas posting in the early 1990s, a colleague Dan Sherman calls Spock spoke with deep reverence about the sun, saying "we really don't understand the value of our sun." Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who wrote the book Above Black about what he calls his secret work communicating with aliens, tells this to Michels as something he heard first-hand.
